title: Owner shaped the Impeller round as three stacked PRs, with PR 2 owning the Meadow page goldens
context: mitosis fuses PRs that write the same file. Flutter 3.47.5 and the Meadow fixes both change the six Meadow page goldens, and the loading-text fix shares meadow_stage.dart with the opening-speed fix. The owner answered each fork. All answers are recorded in docs/specs/impeller-upgrade-meadow-fixes.decisions.md.
options: Keep three PRs: the loading-text fix goes to PR 2, PR 2 owns the Meadow page goldens (PR 1 leaves them failing locally in UTC-6, CI skips them), and the rays Step folds into PR 2
outcome: The owner chose three stacked PRs: #244 toolchain; #245 Meadow on #244; #246 small fixes on #244. Loading text is in PR 2, PR 2 owns the Meadow page goldens, and the rays commit is to be added to PR 2. Also chosen: Android 10 minimum, spruce reworded, unknown mood tolerated, camera_macos SPM, shared window clearance, and Impeller tests run locally and in the gate only.
